releases.title: A smoother site on phones
releases.summary: The site is easier to use on a phone: a simple menu, charts that leave room for the text, and tables you can read without turning your phone.
how: Open the site on your phone and tap Menu

releases.title: Eight more companies planned for the deep dives
releases.summary: The deep-dive page now lists the companies coming next: OpenAI, Meta, Amazon, CoreWeave, Cerebras, Microsoft, Oracle and SK hynix.

releases.title: Up-to-date figures in forecasts, summary and data
releases.summary: The forecasts, monthly summary and data table now use the latest third-quarter results. Anthropic shows as a listed company, SpaceX gets a market value, and Character.AI is marked as ended after its bankruptcy filing.

releases.title: Deep dives for NVIDIA and Google
releases.summary: Two new deep dives, 15 stories each, every number linked to its filing. NVIDIA's starts with its CEO's eleven-day exit and return. Google's starts with its AI building bill and its switch from buying back shares to selling new ones.
how: Open the deep dives
pick NVIDIA or Google at the top

releases.title: Amsterdam Hop: what's on in Amsterdam, on one map
releases.summary: Concerts, clubs, theatre, film and exhibitions from the venues' own sites on one map, with what's open now, festivals and free ferries. Plan your days as real walking routes and build them with friends live.
how: Pick a period like Tonight or This weekend
Tap a pin or press + to add it to your plan
Open Your plan to see the day as a walking route, or invite friends to plan together

releases.title: Field notes for every month, and a welcome back
releases.summary: Each month brings a field note for your half of the world: what to notice outside, why it happens now, and one thing to try this week. Things you've learned come back as a quick question after a day, three days, a week and three weeks, and the home page says where you stopped. It's all kept on your device.
how: Open Go outside to see this month's note
switch hemisphere under it if you need to
Field notes in the footer has the whole year

releases.title: Share any photo, film or simulation
releases.summary: Each photo, film and simulation now has a quiet Share link. Whoever opens it lands right on that picture, with its credit, and a few gentle pointers to more.
how: Find "Share" at the end of a picture's credit line
on a phone it opens your share sheet, on a computer it copies the link

releases.title: Four new real films: sunflowers, slime mould and more
releases.summary: Watch a young sunflower follow the sun, a slime mould spread towards food, a purple shamrock fold its leaves at dusk, and the living insides of onion cells streaming under a microscope. Two new pages explain sleeping leaves and streaming cells, with a guess to try first.
how: Open Wander, then the Meadow
choose Sunflowers keep time

releases.title: Shared links now show the right picture
releases.summary: Share any page of Understory and the preview now shows that page's own photo, with its photographer credit, instead of the same picture every time. A link to the Venus flytrap shows the flytrap.
how: Open any page
copy its address
paste it into a chat or a post

releases.title: Watch seedlings find the light, on real film
releases.summary: The "Can a plant see?" chapter now has three real time-lapse films: peas turning green after thirteen days in the dark, tomato seedlings leaning towards a window, and mung beans lit from below. Scrub through each one; the pea film counts the real hours.
how: Open Senses, then Can a plant see?
pick a film under the player
drag the slider to move through time

releases.title: One clear sound button in the header
releases.summary: The header now has a single speaker button for the woodland sound. Films still have their own pause button, and "Films: playing" at the foot of every page pauses them all at once.

releases.title: Through time: 3.5 billion years of plants in ten stops
releases.summary: A new journey from bacteria that learned to eat light to the oldest trees alive. Ten stops with real fossils: the first plants to come ashore (with fungi already inside them), the first forests, seeds, coal swamps, ginkgo, the first flowers and the ferns that came back after the asteroid. A clock squeezes Earth's history into one day: plants arrive at 9.31 p.m.
how: Open Through time in the menu
guess at each stop
the strip under the header shows the time on Earth's day

releases.title: Grow the network: how fungi trade with roots
releases.summary: A new simulation at the fungal-threads stop: one fungus, two roots, and a guess about where the fungus sends its phosphorus. Then change who pays more sugar and watch the trade follow, next to a real microscope photo of the fungus inside a root.
how: Open the Descent
go to stop v, Fungal threads
answer the guess under the drawing
then choose who pays more

releases.title: Understory has a new address
releases.summary: Understory now lives at understory.arian-shafa.xyz, the same name as the site. Old plants.arian-shafa.xyz links still work and take you to the same page.

releases.title: Anthropic deep dive: final IPO price and the founders' sale
releases.summary: The Anthropic deep dive now uses the final prospectus: $83 a share, 980 million shares and $104.8B raised. A new section explains the co-founders' sale: about $280M each, sold within the IPO itself and confirmed by their insider reports.
how: Open the deep dive
in "The offering", click Read more under "The founders sell a little"

releases.title: Podcasts too: picks and taste from what you listen to
releases.summary: Ask for books, podcasts or both in the Find sentence. Podcast picks come with episode length, whether the show is still running and where to start, and you can import your podcast subscriptions so Find understands your taste better.
how: Tap “3 books” in the sentence and slide some picks over to podcasts
or import your subscriptions (OPML) in Library

releases.title: JobHop: impact jobs around Amsterdam, scored for you
releases.summary: Live roles from charities, B Corps, social enterprises and climate start-ups around Amsterdam, straight from their own job pages. Set what matters to you and every role gets a score, with a source behind each one.
how: Open JobHop and look around the map
Press Your weights and pick what matters to you
Open a role to see where each score comes from

releases.title: My network demo now sits with my other projects
releases.summary: The playable network demo has its own card on the homepage, so you can find it next to everything else I've built. Links to it now show a picture of the rings too.

releases.title: Understory: the hidden lives of plants
releases.summary: A new site about what plants, fungi and forests are doing all day. Descend through a forest from the canopy to the permafrost, wander four plates, or ask plants eight questions, with real photos and film, a guess before every answer, and every claim traced to its source.
how: Open Understory and press Begin at the top
Guess, then see the answer
Find what you learned in your journal

releases.title: Ask for your next book in one sentence
releases.summary: Find now reads like a sentence: choose a kind of book, name books it should be like, pick how it should feel and how long you have. Books you loved become favourites on their own, and your taste is editable right there.
how: Tap an underlined part of the sentence
name a book you love
press Find 3 books

releases.title: A playable demo of my network tool
releases.summary: See how I map who I know and find who could help a friend get a job, using a made-up network of 900 people. No real names, and nothing you click leaves the page.
how: Open the page
search for something like "UX", or tap the rings and numbers to filter

releases.title: Endless “3 more” picks, and every book one click away
releases.summary: “Show 3 more” now keeps going for as long as you like and remembers how far you got. Each pick’s title opens the book on Goodreads, with an Open Library link beside it, so there’s no copying titles into a search engine.
how: Run a round of picks
press Show 3 more as often as you like
click a title to read about the book

releases.title: Picks that follow the books you name, no export needed
releases.summary: No Goodreads export? Name a few books you loved and a few that didn't work, and your picks, their reasons and your reader portrait now follow them. Each title shows what it matched as you type it.
how: Choose "Start with 5 books you loved"
type a few titles, adding "by" and the author if a title is common
save and find your first picks

releases.title: Books: three honest picks for your next read
releases.summary: A new book recommender. Bring your Goodreads export, say how you feel today, and get three picks, each with a reason and an honest heads-up. It runs in your browser, so your library never leaves your device.
how: Import your Goodreads export or start with five books you loved
tap how you feel
press Find my next book

releases.title: Read more about every chart in the deep dives
releases.summary: Each step of the Anthropic and SpaceX deep dives now explains more, with a Read more panel for longer answers and a short summary at the end of each story. The Anthropic lock-up schedule is also corrected.
how: Open a deep dive
under a step, tap Read more

releases.title: Clearer previews when you share Hope
releases.summary: A shared Hope link now explains itself: today's good news next to decades of progress data you can check.

releases.title: A sharper preview image when you share the Anthropic deep dive
releases.summary: The image shown when you share the Anthropic deep dive is now sharper and easier to read on LinkedIn and other apps.

releases.title: Sharing the Anthropic deep dive shows its own preview
releases.summary: Links to the Anthropic deep dive now show its own title, description and image when you share them, and the browser tab names the page.

releases.title: Clearer previews when you share the AI Bubble Tracker
releases.summary: A shared link now says what you'll find: revenue, burn, users and valuations for 20+ AI companies side by side.

releases.title: Anthropic's IPO, in fifteen short stories
releases.summary: The Anthropic deep dive now covers the listing itself: the price range, seven partners buying in, what a share cost in each round, lock-ups and the latest quarter. The numbers at the top follow the IPO on their own, from price range to IPO price to the daily share price.
how: Open Deep dive
Scroll through the Anthropic stories

releases.title: Programme updates are back
releases.summary: Since 15 November the planner kept showing the 14 November programme, because IDFA renamed one cinema (Rialto SILO). The latest times and changes come through again, and a renamed hall will no longer hold up the daily update.

releases.title: Seven hands-on labs, one for every layer
releases.summary: Every lab now teaches one idea by doing: wire switches into a circuit that adds, play the next-word game a model plays, keep a rack cool, and guess which uses more energy, an AI question or your kettle. All of them live under Play.
how: Open Play
pick any lab

releases.title: A warmer look: moss, marigold and friendlier headings
releases.summary: Understanding AI has new, earthier colours (moss green and marigold on cream, with a warm dark mode) and livelier headings, so it feels less like a manual and more like a place to explore.

releases.title: Clearer arrows on the map of meaning
releases.summary: On the map-of-meaning step, the arrows from “king” to “queen” and from “man” to “woman” no longer run over the words.

releases.title: Calmer on your phone: one step at a time
releases.summary: On phones and small tablets the explainer now starts as a simple list of the seven layers. Each step shows one picture and a few sentences, with the quick question and the deeper detail a tap away.
how: Open the site on your phone
tap a layer or Start with your question
tap Check yourself or Go deeper when you want more

releases.title: Quoth for Android: a private voice keyboard
releases.summary: A free Android keyboard that turns your speech into clean text in any app, entirely on your phone. It's in a closed test on Google Play first.

releases.title: Plan IDFA and Art Week with DocuHop and ArtHop
releases.summary: MuseumHop now points to its two new sister planners: DocuHop for IDFA (12–22 Nov) and ArtHop for Amsterdam Art Week (18–22 Nov). Both are free, unofficial fan projects.
how: Open MuseumHop
tap DocuHop or ArtHop in the banner at the top

releases.title: Understanding AI: what happens behind a chatbot's answer
releases.summary: A new interactive explainer. Zoom from the question you type through the model, its training, the chips and the data centre, down to the electricity it runs on, with plain words, hands-on labs and a quiz at every step.
how: Open the site
click a layer or press Start with your question
try the labs under Play

releases.title: Museumnacht is over: tell us what to build next
releases.summary: MuseumHop now says what's coming next, a planner for Amsterdam Art Week, and asks which event you'd like a planner for. Your email is optional and only used to reply.

releases.title: Plans now work for sites that were hard to read
releases.summary: Some websites, especially apps that redirect while loading, made the analysis fail after a long wait. To One now reads those pages another way, and tells you plainly when a site can't be reached.

releases.title: MuseumHop opens faster on your first visit
releases.summary: New visitors no longer take a detour through the old MuseumHopper address before the planner loads. Links to the old address still bring you here with your nights and name.

releases.title: Open any release to see what changed
releases.summary: Each row in the shipping log now opens to show what the release does, how to use it, and a link straight to the change on its site.

releases.title: A guided first visit, and help on every page
releases.summary: First-time readers get a three-step intro. A new ? button opens help with a short tour of the page you are on.
how: Tap the ? in the header, or press ? on a keyboard.
Pick “Tour this page” to see what each part does.
Use “Replay the intro” to see the welcome again.

releases.title: The $72.4B line in Anthropic’s accounts, explained
releases.summary: Story 4c of the Anthropic deep dive now answers seven short questions about one accounting line, each linked to its page in the prospectus.
how: Open Deep dive and pick Anthropic.
Scroll to story 4, “One accounting line”.

releases.title: Every page now ends with a sunset and three doors
releases.summary: A reader said reaching the end of Hope felt like the good news had run out. Each page now ends calmly, with three places to go next.
how: Scroll to the bottom of Today, Past & Present or Hopeful Past.
Pick a door: tomorrow’s newsletter, another page, or a friend site.

releases.title: Hopeful Past, retold as a single day
releases.summary: Two centuries of progress squeezed into one day: 1820 is midnight and today is 23:59, about 8.6 years per hour.
how: Open Hopeful Past.
Tap a pin on the day clock to jump to that moment.
Open a decade below to see every event in it, with sources.

releases.title: A coach that tells you why a move is smart
releases.summary: Built on a friend’s feedback: Go Dojo now explains good and bad moves with six truths and twelve rules of thumb, adds smart-move drills, and is easier on a phone.
how: Play a game and tap Coach after any move.
Try the smart-move drills from the Lessons page.

releases.title: SpaceX deep dive, with numbers that update themselves
releases.summary: SpaceX’s prospectus and its last two quarterly reports, told as 11 scrolling stories. The headline numbers refresh daily from SEC filings.
how: Open Deep dive and tap the SpaceX chip.
When a newer filing appears, the page links to it.

releases.title: A three-step intro and a new help panel
releases.summary: New visitors learn the question, the five-layer stack and how to read a bubble in three steps. Companies, Forecasts and Summary moved to the new design.
how: Press ? or tap the ? button.
Choose “What can I do?” for every feature and shortcut.

releases.title: Deep dive: Anthropic’s IPO prospectus
releases.summary: A new Deep dive tab tells the S-1 as eleven stories. One chart stays on screen and highlights each point as you scroll.
how: Open the Deep dive tab.
Scroll. The chart follows and lights up the part being discussed.

releases.title: New overview: the AI layer cake, in bubbles
releases.summary: The homepage is a new overview with year and quarter filters, a play-through timeline, period comparison and a source on every number.
how: Use the sidebar to switch year or quarter.
Press play to watch the bubbles move over time.
Click any bubble for its sources.

releases.title: Newsletter sign-up you can trust
releases.summary: Subscribing now asks you to confirm by email, unsubscribing deletes your address, and a new privacy page says exactly what is stored.
how: Sign up at the bottom of any page.
Click the link in the confirmation email.

releases.title: Pick your mood: the new Today page
releases.summary: Hope now opens on a Today page where you choose the kind of good news you want, plus a new Past & Present page that sets stories next to long-run data.
how: Choose a mood: Surprise me, Warm my heart, Blow my mind or Show me what works.
Use Refine to search or filter by place.
Open Past & Present to see a story beside its Our World in Data chart.

releases.title: Quoth is free for every Mac
releases.summary: One download, no Homebrew: transcription engines ship inside the app, the right model downloads on first run, and updates install themselves.
how: Download the DMG from arian-shafa.xyz/quoth.
The setup page suggests a model for your Mac’s memory.
Use Email the Developer in the menu bar to send feedback.
